aboutGame.title: What is Moonfrost?
paragraphs: Moonfrost is a premium cosy life-sim RPG developed by Oxalis Games, set in a world devastated by constant meteor storms called the Frost Fall. As a Frost Hunter, you harness the power of these icy meteors to rebuild a shattered village.

Featuring handcrafted pixel art, dynamic lighting, and a haunting original soundtrack, Moonfrost blends farming, fishing, crafting, cooking, and relationship building with a compelling narrative mystery — uncovering the truth behind the ominous Second Moon.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Moonfrost.

items.question: What is Moonfrost?
items.answer: Moonfrost is a premium cosy life-sim RPG developed by Oxalis Games. Players take on the role of a Frost Hunter, harnessing the power of icy meteors to rebuild a shattered village through farming, fishing, crafting, cooking, and relationship building.

items.question: What platforms is Moonfrost available on?
items.answer: Moonfrost is available on Steam and Epic Games Store for PC, with Steam Deck verification. It launched into Early Access on 12 October 2026.

items.question: How much story content is in the Early Access release?
items.answer: The Early Access release includes the first half of the main storyline, the first 20 temple rooms, and several restorable village businesses. The full story and remaining content are planned for the version 1.0 release.

items.question: Are there redeem codes for Moonfrost?
items.answer: No official redeem codes or a code redemption system have been verified on the official Moonfrost website or Steam listing. This wiki will be updated if codes become available.

items.question: How many villagers can I befriend in Early Access?
items.answer: Moonfrost Early Access includes 11 befriendable villagers, with friendship capped at level 3. All friendship events and romance options are planned for the full version 1.0 release.

items.question: Does Moonfrost support multiplayer?
items.answer: Moonfrost is a single-player experience. Multiplayer features are not listed in the official game description or Early Access release notes.
